title: Processing a Change from Scheduled Payments to the HECM Line of Credit
content:
When a borrower's signed payout plan change request moves a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan off scheduled payments onto the HECM Line of Credit, Cedarline processes the change on the handling date and books the payment release, the amount of the scheduled payments not yet made that returns to the available line.

**Conditions and effect.**

- A plan change is processed only while the loan status is active.
- A loan carries at most one submitted payout plan change request at a time, so the submitted change request onto the HECM Line of Credit is a single request.
- The change also charges the plan's plan change fee to the loan balance, sets the plan to HECM Line of Credit with a scheduled payment of 0.00, a term of 0 months and no first payment month, and marks the request processed.

Once processed, the request no longer shows request status submitted, the payment release has raised the available line, and the loan shows the HECM Line of Credit with no scheduled payment.

## Processing the change: `convert_payout_plan_to_line_d82e9c7e`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `convert_payout_plan_to_line_d82e9c7e` and calls it. One call, dated today, books a release entry returning the stated amount to the loan's available line, switches the loan's payout plan to HECM Line of Credit with no scheduled payment (payment 0.00, term 0, no start month), charges the plan change processing fee of 20.00 USD to the loan balance, and marks the request processed.

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `hecm_loan_id` | Reference number of the HECM loan whose plan changes, as returned by the HECM loan lookup. |
| `hecm_request_id` | Reference number of the borrower's signed payout plan change request on that loan, as returned by the HECM request lookup. |
| `release_amount` | The amount returned to the available line, in US dollars as a positive decimal number with exactly 2 decimal places; stored as given, rounded half up to the cent. |

**Return.** A sentence beginning "Plan change processed" gives the release entry reference (beginning "hrl_"), the processing fee entry reference (beginning "hpf_"), the request reference, the released amount and the 20.00 USD fee with 2 decimals, the effective date (today), the new payout plan HECM Line of Credit, and the loan's new available line and new balance; it means the change, the release and the fee are all booked and the request is processed.
